name: nomi
description: An AI sales employee a factory can trust in front of a real buyer. Answers WhatsApp enquiries in English, 中文 and العربية — quotes only from the owner's own price rules, never states a price, spec or certification she was not given, and hands the conversation to a person when she cannot answer safely.

scripts.boundaries: node tools/check-boundaries.mjs && node tools/check-reachable.mjs && node tools/check-reachable.mjs --symbols --ratchet
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run boundaries && npm run test
